headline: Court freezes assets of Lumen Logistics amid insolvency petition
body: A court froze assets of Lumen Logistics after creditors filed an insolvency petition. Operations continue under court supervision.

headline: Lumen Logistics faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Lumen Logistics. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Lumen Logistics executives arrested in bribery probe
body: Authorities detained senior executives of Lumen Logistics as part of a bribery investigation. The board has suspended the individuals pending the outcome.

headline: Lumen Logistics cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Lumen Logistics lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.

headline: Data breach at Lumen Logistics exposes customer records
body: Lumen Logistics disclosed unauthorized access to systems holding customer records. Regulators have been notified and affected customers are being contacted.

headline: Lumen Logistics reports record quarterly revenue
body: Lumen Logistics reported revenue growth of 12% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Lumen Logistics opens new production line in Pune
body: Lumen Logistics commissioned a new line at its Pune site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Lumen Logistics wins quality award from industry association
body: Lumen Logistics received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.
